summary: Website for selling one-of-a-kind paintings: public gallery/listings with contact email for purchases, plus an admin dashboard to upload/manage paintings. No auction/bidding or user registration.
architectural_notes: No auction feature; no user registration/login required. Purchases handled via direct email contact (offgridsecrets@gmail.com).
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimalist wordmark logo on transparent background, dark editorial style (dark-predictions-wordmark.dim_1200x300.png)
- Abstract dark textured hero background suitable for an art gallery landing section (gallery-hero-texture.dim_2400x1350.png)

existing_features.title: Remove the auction/bidding feature entirely, including any auction navigation, pages, backend endpoints, data models, and UI copy that references auctions, bidding, or user registration for bidding.

Implement a purchase/contact flow based on a displayed email address: show the contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" on all public painting listing pages and painting detail pages, including a clear call-to-action link using a mailto: link.

Build the core public gallery for the site titled "Dark Predictions Paintings": a home/gallery page that lists all paintings for sale, and a detail view per painting showing image(s), title, description, and price, plus the purchase contact email.

Implement an admin dashboard that allows the admin to create, edit, and delete painting listings with fields: title, description, price, and image(s). The dashboard must display the admin contact email "offgridsecrets@gmail.com" in the admin UI.
Add a mission statement section on the public site stating that proceeds support building and developing affordable modern housing for the local community.

Add authentication for accessing the admin dashboard using Internet Identity (no email-based login). Restrict all admin-only backend methods (create/update/delete paintings) so they can only be called by authenticated admin identity/identities configured for the app.

Create and apply a cohesive visual theme suitable for a premium, one-of-a-kind painting gallery (consistent typography, spacing, and color system). Use a distinct style (e.g., dark editorial/noir gallery aesthetic) and apply it consistently across the public site and admin dashboard; do not use a blue/purple primary palette.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create public-facing site for “Dark Predictions Paintings” to showcase paintings for sale (listings with title, description, price, images).
Admin dashboard to upload, title, describe, price, and manage painting listings using the admin email offgridsecrets@gmail.com.
Remove auction/bidding section and instead display contact email offgridsecrets@gmail.com for users to email to buy.
Include mission statement: proceeds support building/developing affordable modern housing for the local community.
